items.t: Roof of a water tower in NYC where a rare family of barn owls nested has been removed
items.x: The first documented barn owl nest in modern Manhattan was exposed when a water tower roof was removed, sparking criticism and concern.

items.t: Coach June Jones dies at 73
items.x: June Jones, the trailblazing coach who led the University of Hawaii to its greatest era, has died at 73. He also spent time coaching in the NFL and was a former Atlanta Falcons quarterback.
